brief: Low open-front livestock loafing shed about 36 ft long and 14 ft deep, framed on round wooden posts set on a concrete curb, with a shallow gable roof of galvanized corrugated metal. The back wall and the enclosed end bay are sheathed in grey corrugated metal over wood girts; the long front is open in two wide bays with a board gate propped across one. A rusty pipe-and-wire gate hangs at the corner, white steel pipe corrals stand to the side, and dry prairie grass grows up to the curb. (Walls are corrugated metal; nearest wall word is board_and_batten.)
